name: MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE: NURGLINGS
description: Nurglings are malicious plague mites that pour across the battlefield in giggling masses. These foul imps might seem almost amusing from a distance, yet the illusion is shattered as the Nurglings spill forth to engulf their screaming victims in a rancid avalanche of needle fangs, filthy talons, and bloated flesh.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds three bases of Nurglings, piles of diminutive daemons for your Death Guard or Chaos Daemons armies in games of Warhammer 40,000, or your Maggotkin of Nurgle armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. What they may lack in individual strength, they make up for in sheer numbers, making them ideal for tying up enemy units or claiming vital objectives. Every swarm has front, back, and middle ranks – each comprised of wriggling little horned beasts covered in sores, cuts, and lumps. They also come in a variety of characterful poses. You can make 27 unique combinations of Nurgling towers, with individual Nurglings left over for use on bases for the rest of your army.</br></br>This kit comprises 16 plastic components, and 3x Citadel 40mm Round Bases. These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
